correctness.rationale: The exact Gallo–Videla path algebra has dim 3n-3 (n≥2), central W dimension n-2, and an odd (2n-1)-dimensional noncentral alternating Kirillov matrix; thus rank≤2n-2 for any field including char 2. Evaluating each length-two path at 1 gives D^T x=0 equivalent to x3=0, x_(n-2)=0 and x_i=x_(i+3). D has rank n-1 for n mod 3≠2, and rank n-2 otherwise. In the deficient residue class the edge coefficient C12=1 restricts nondegenerately to its two-dimensional left kernel, restoring full allowed rank. This proves index n-1 and the claimed explicit radical W⊕kz_n; n=2 is Heisenberg with index one, n=1 abelian with index one. Independently reconstructed the integer D,C blocks and exact rational ranks for n=3..13, including the mod-three drop. The attached verify.py was read as a finite checker; no output log was accepted as an infinite proof.
